title: Customer Churn Prediction
description: Predicting high-risk customers likely to churn using ensemble learning techniques.
problem: A telecommunications company is losing customers to competitors. They need to identify churn patterns to improve retention.
dataset: Telco Customer Churn dataset from Kaggle containing 7,000+ customer records.
approach: Cleaned data, performed EDA to find key churn drivers, implemented Random Forest and XGBoost models, optimized with GridSearch.
results: Achieved an F1-score of 0.85, identifying that contract duration and monthly charges were the primary predictors.

title: E-commerce Sales Insights
description: Dynamic Power BI dashboard visualizing sales trends, customer demographics, and regional performance.
problem: Business managers lacked real-time visibility into sales performance across different regions and product categories.
dataset: Internal sales database with over 50,000 transactions and customer metadata.
approach: Used SQL to extract and transform data, established star schema in Power BI, created complex DAX measures for YTD and MoM growth.
results: Reduced reporting time by 60% and identified a 15% drop in sales in the Northern region due to shipping delays.

title: Database Performance Tuning
description: Optimizing complex SQL queries for a high-traffic production database.
problem: Batch processing jobs were taking over 4 hours to complete, causing downstream data latency issues.
dataset: Proprietary database logs and execution plans from a 1TB PostgreSQL environment.
approach: Analyzed slow query logs, identified missing indexes, refactored nested subqueries into CTEs, and optimized join orders.
results: Reduced job execution time from 4.5 hours to 35 minutes, a 90% increase in performance.

title: Market Basket Analysis
description: Discovering product association rules using the Apriori algorithm to drive cross-selling.
problem: A grocery retailer wanted to optimize shelf placement and create effective 'buy-one-get-one' offers.
dataset: Retail transactional data containing 10,000+ unique receipts.
approach: Preprocessed transaction data into one-hot encoded format, applied Apriori algorithm, and analyzed support, confidence, and lift.
results: Discovered strong associations between certain organic snacks and premium dairy products, leading to a 5% increase in cross-sales.
